user.title: Connect to PoolPro Sync
user.description: Enter your pool controller's device ID, found in the PoolPro Sync app's device details screen (a MAC-like string, e.g. "AABBCC112233"). The device model is detected automatically - there's nothing else to look up.

error.invalid_auth: Could not authenticate with PoolPro Sync.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to PoolPro Sync, or the device ID was not found.
